sentences.en: The exchange rates are posted daily outside the cashier's office.
sentences.zh: 现金窗口外每天都会公布汇率。

sentences.en: He seems to be oppressed by his monotonous daily life.
sentences.zh: 他似乎被单调的日常生活压得喘不过气。

sentences.en: That's one of the conventions of our daily life.
sentences.zh: 那可是我们日常生活中的一种惯例。
